2) If you were to take all the significant relationships of model parameters with traits, could you build a multivariate model that predicts LFMmin, and then compare it to observed? The value would be for modelers who have functional trait databases, to show how close we can get in predictions based only on the functional traits

#Read in data: 

```{r}
concept_df <- read_csv(here("data", "concept_df.csv")) %>% 
  filter(group == "species") %>% 
  select(mwp, ilfm, species, study) 

q3_df <- read_csv(here("data", "q3_df.csv"))

q4_df <- merge(concept_df, q3_df, by = c("species")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(sla)) %>%
  mutate(
    psi_z = as.numeric(scale(mwp)),   # or psi_md if that’s the column name
    sla_z = as.numeric(scale(sla))
  )

q4_df %>% write_csv(here("data", "q4_df.csv"))
```

#Table S5: Final model selection
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(Metrics)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(here)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Prepare the Master Dataset
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# We must drop NAs for all variables used in ANY of the 9 models
# so they are all compared on the exact same dataset.
df_mod <- q4_df %>%
  filter(!species %in% c("SALLEU", "SALMEL")) %>%  # Salvias are outliers (see Q3)
  filter(
    !is.na(mwp), !is.na(ilfm), !is.na(plc50_stem), !is.na(sla), 
    !is.na(ldmc), !is.na(psi_tlp), !is.na(functional_type), !is.na(species)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    mwp_z    = as.numeric(scale(mwp)),
    p50_z    = as.numeric(scale(plc50_stem)),
    sla_z    = as.numeric(scale(sla)),
    tlp_z    = as.numeric(scale(psi_tlp)),
    ldmc_z   = as.numeric(scale(ldmc)),
    functional_type = as.factor(functional_type)
  )

# VIF Check
# Traits vary only among species, so check collinearity on one row per species
# (observation-level VIFs weight species by sample size and pseudoreplicate).
# VIF = diagonal of the inverse correlation matrix of the predictors.
species_traits <- df_mod %>%
  distinct(species, plc50_stem, sla, ldmc, psi_tlp, functional_type) %>%
  mutate(gymnosperm = as.numeric(functional_type == "gymnosperm")) %>%
  select(plc50_stem, sla, ldmc, psi_tlp, gymnosperm)
cat("Species n:", nrow(species_traits), "\n")
cat("Trait correlations (species level):\n")
print(round(cor(species_traits), 2))
cat("VIF (species level):\n")
print(round(diag(solve(cor(species_traits))), 2))

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Define Your 9 A Priori Models
# ---------------------------------------------------------
formulas <- list(
  "P50 + SLA + LDMC + TLP" = ilfm ~ mwp_z * p50_z + mwp_z * sla_z + mwp_z * ldmc_z + mwp_z * tlp_z + (mwp_z | species),
  
  "P50 + SLA + LDMC + TLP + F. Type" = ilfm ~ mwp_z * p50_z + mwp_z * sla_z + mwp_z * ldmc_z + functional_type * mwp_z + mwp_z * tlp_z + (mwp_z | species),
  
  "P50 + SLA + LDMC + F. Type" = ilfm ~ mwp_z * p50_z + mwp_z * sla_z + mwp_z * ldmc_z + functional_type * mwp_z + (mwp_z | species),
  
  "TLP + SLA + LDMC + F. Type" = ilfm ~ mwp_z * tlp_z + mwp_z * sla_z + mwp_z * ldmc_z + functional_type * mwp_z + (mwp_z | species),
  
  "P50 + SLA + LDMC" = ilfm ~ mwp_z * p50_z + mwp_z * sla_z + mwp_z * ldmc_z + (mwp_z | species),
  
  "SLA + LDMC + F. Type" = ilfm ~ mwp_z * sla_z + mwp_z * ldmc_z + functional_type * mwp_z + (mwp_z | species),
  
  "LDMC + F. Type" = ilfm ~ mwp_z * ldmc_z +  functional_type * mwp_z + (mwp_z | species),
  
  "SLA + F. Type" = ilfm ~ mwp_z * sla_z + functional_type * mwp_z + (mwp_z | species),
  
  "SLA Only" = ilfm ~ mwp_z * sla_z + (mwp_z | species),
  
  # P50 + TLP + F. Type (Hydraulics only, no leaf economics)
  "TLP + P50 + F. Type" = ilfm ~ mwp_z * p50_z + mwp_z * tlp_z + functional_type * mwp_z + (mwp_z | species),
  
  "TLP Only" = ilfm ~ mwp_z * tlp_z + (mwp_z | species),
  
  "P50 Only" = ilfm ~ mwp_z * p50_z+ (mwp_z | species),
  
  "LDMC Only" = ilfm ~ mwp_z * ldmc_z+ (mwp_z | species),
  
  "F.Type Only" = ilfm ~ mwp_z * functional_type + (mwp_z | species),
  
  "WP Only (Null)" = ilfm ~ mwp_z + (mwp_z | species)
)
formulas_all <- formulas

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Evaluate Models and Run Cross-Validation
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Random slopes (mwp_z | species) need a more robust optimizer
ctrl_rs <- lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa")

# Cross-validated R2 with every species weighted equally (weights = 1 / n obs per species),
# so species with many observations do not dominate the score
r2_species_weighted <- function(obs, pred, species) {
  w <- 1 / as.numeric(table(species)[as.character(species)])
  1 - sum(w * (obs - pred)^2) / sum(w * (obs - weighted.mean(obs, w))^2)
}

results_list <- list()
species_list <- unique(df_mod$species)

cat("Running evaluations and cross-validation for 9 hypothesis-driven models...\n")

for(model_name in names(formulas)) {
  
  current_formula <- formulas[[model_name]]
  
  # A. Fit Full Model (REML = FALSE is required to compare fixed effects with AIC)
  full_mod <- lmer(current_formula, data = df_mod, REML = FALSE, control = ctrl_rs)
  
  # B. Calculate AIC & In-Sample R2
  mod_aic <- AIC(full_mod)
  in_sample_preds <- predict(full_mod)
  in_sample_r2 <- cor(df_mod$ilfm, in_sample_preds)^2
  
  # C. Leave-One-Species-Out CV Loop
  cv_preds <- numeric(nrow(df_mod))
  
  for(sp in species_list) {
    train_data <- df_mod %>% filter(species != sp)
    test_data  <- df_mod %>% filter(species == sp)
    
    cv_mod <- lmer(current_formula, data = train_data, REML = FALSE, control = ctrl_rs)
    cv_preds[df_mod$species == sp] <- predict(cv_mod, newdata = test_data, allow.new.levels = TRUE)
  }
  cv_r2 <- r2_species_weighted(df_mod$ilfm, cv_preds, df_mod$species)
  cv_r2_pooled <- cor(df_mod$ilfm, cv_preds)^2
  
  # D. Store Results
  results_list[[model_name]] <- data.frame(
    Model = model_name,
    AIC = mod_aic,
    In_Sample_R2 = in_sample_r2,
    Cross_Val_R2 = cv_r2,
    Cross_Val_R2_pooled = cv_r2_pooled
  )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Format the Dataframe
# ---------------------------------------------------------
model_comparison_df <- do.call(rbind, results_list)

min_aic <- min(model_comparison_df$AIC)

final_df <- model_comparison_df %>%
  mutate(Delta_AIC = AIC - min_aic) %>%
  arrange(Delta_AIC) %>%
  # Round numbers for clean presentation
  mutate(
    AIC = round(AIC, 1),
    Delta_AIC = round(Delta_AIC, 1),
    In_Sample_R2 = round(In_Sample_R2, 3),
    Cross_Val_R2 = round(Cross_Val_R2, 3),
    Cross_Val_R2_pooled = round(Cross_Val_R2_pooled, 3)
  ) %>%
  # Clean up headers
  rename(
    `Candidate Model` = Model,
    `Delta AIC` = Delta_AIC,
    `In-Sample R-squared` = In_Sample_R2,
    `Cross-Val R-squared (species-weighted)` = Cross_Val_R2,
    `Cross-Val R-squared (pooled obs)` = Cross_Val_R2_pooled
  )

rownames(final_df) <- NULL

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Create and Save the Publication kable Table
# ---------------------------------------------------------
pub_table <- kable(final_df, format = "html", escape = FALSE, align = "lccccc") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE, position = "left") %>%
  # Highlight the best model row in bold
  row_spec(1, bold = TRUE) 

# Print to Viewer
pub_table

# Save as an HTML file for easy copy/pasting into Word
write.csv(final_df, here("output", "tables", "Table_S07_model_comparison_all.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
tryCatch(save_kable(pub_table, file = here("output", "tables", "Table_S07_model_comparison_all.html")), error = function(e) message("Note: HTML table skipped (pandoc not available)"))

cat("Done! Table saved to figures/Table_Hypothesis_Models.html\n")

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Filter, Format, and Rank
# ---------------------------------------------------------
model_comparison_df <- do.call(rbind, results_list)

min_aic <- min(model_comparison_df$AIC)

final_df <- model_comparison_df %>%
  mutate(Delta_AIC = AIC - min_aic) %>%
  # Table S7: models within 10 AIC of the best, plus the null
  filter(Delta_AIC <= 10 | Model == "WP Only (Null)") %>%
  arrange(Delta_AIC) %>%
  # Round numbers for clean presentation
  mutate(
    AIC = round(AIC, 1),
    Delta_AIC = round(Delta_AIC, 1),
    In_Sample_R2 = round(In_Sample_R2, 3),
    Cross_Val_R2 = round(Cross_Val_R2, 3),
    Cross_Val_R2_pooled = round(Cross_Val_R2_pooled, 3)
  ) %>%
  # Clean up headers
  rename(
    `Candidate Model` = Model,
    `Delta AIC` = Delta_AIC,
    `In-Sample R-squared` = In_Sample_R2,
    `Cross-Val R-squared (species-weighted)` = Cross_Val_R2,
    `Cross-Val R-squared (pooled obs)` = Cross_Val_R2_pooled
  )

rownames(final_df) <- NULL

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Create and Save the Publication kable Table
# ---------------------------------------------------------
pub_table <- kable(final_df, format = "html", escape = FALSE, align = "lccccc") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE, position = "left") %>%
  row_spec(1, bold = TRUE) 

# Print to Viewer
pub_table

# Save as an HTML file for easy copy/pasting into Word
write.csv(final_df, here("output", "tables", "Table_S07_model_comparison.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
tryCatch(save_kable(pub_table, file = here("output", "tables", "Table_S07_model_comparison.html")), error = function(e) message("Note: HTML table skipped (pandoc not available)"))

cat("Done! Table saved to figures/Table_Hypothesis_Models_Filtered.html\n")
```


####v2: Colored points 
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(Metrics) # for calculating RMSE and R-squared
library(here)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Load, clean data, and assign plot groups
# ---------------------------------------------------------
df <- q4_df

# Fig 9 applies the CV-selected model (LDMC + functional type) to every species it can be
# fit to: only Psi, LDMC and functional type are required, so this includes the two Salvia
# and species without P50/SLA/TLP (23 species), unlike the Table S7 comparison (17).
df_mod <- df %>%
  filter(!is.na(mwp), !is.na(ilfm), !is.na(ldmc), !is.na(functional_type), !is.na(species)) %>%
  # Standardize continuous predictors (z-scores)
  mutate(
    mwp_z = as.numeric(scale(mwp)),
    ldmc_z = as.numeric(scale(ldmc))
  ) %>%
  # Create the grouping variable for the plot colors
  mutate(
    plot_group = case_when(
      grepl("gymnosperm", functional_type, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Gymnosperm",
      grepl("sal", species, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Salvia",
      TRUE ~ "Other Angiosperm"
    ),
    # Make it a factor to control the legend order
    plot_group = factor(plot_group, levels = c("Gymnosperm", "Salvia", "Other Angiosperm"))
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Frequentist Framework (lmer)
# ---------------------------------------------------------
freq_mod <- lmer(
  ilfm ~ mwp_z * ldmc_z + functional_type * mwp_z + (mwp_z | species),
  data = df_mod,
  REML = TRUE,
  control = ctrl_rs
)

# summary() will now give you p-values
summary(freq_mod)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Model Predictions (In-Sample and Out-of-Sample)
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# In-Sample
df_mod$predicted_ilfm <- predict(freq_mod)
in_sample_r2 <- cor(df_mod$ilfm, df_mod$predicted_ilfm)^2
in_sample_rmse <- rmse(df_mod$ilfm, df_mod$predicted_ilfm)

# Out-of-Sample (Leave-One-Species-Out)
df_mod$cv_predicted_ilfm <- NA
species_list <- unique(df_mod$species)

for(sp in species_list) {
  train_data <- df_mod %>% filter(species != sp)
  test_data <- df_mod %>% filter(species == sp)
  
  temp_mod <- lmer(
    ilfm ~ mwp_z * ldmc_z + functional_type * mwp_z + (mwp_z | species),
    data = train_data,
    REML = FALSE,
    control = ctrl_rs
  )
  
  preds <- predict(temp_mod, newdata = test_data, allow.new.levels = TRUE)
  df_mod$cv_predicted_ilfm[df_mod$species == sp] <- preds
}

cv_r2 <- r2_species_weighted(df_mod$ilfm, df_mod$cv_predicted_ilfm, df_mod$species)
cv_rmse <- rmse(df_mod$ilfm, df_mod$cv_predicted_ilfm)

# Psi-only comparison on the same species (in-sample and leave-one-species-out)
null_mod <- lmer(ilfm ~ mwp_z + (mwp_z | species), data = df_mod, REML = TRUE, control = ctrl_rs)
null_in_r2 <- cor(df_mod$ilfm, predict(null_mod))^2
df_mod$cv_null_ilfm <- NA
for (sp in species_list) {
  m0 <- lmer(ilfm ~ mwp_z + (mwp_z | species), data = filter(df_mod, species != sp),
             REML = FALSE, control = ctrl_rs)
  df_mod$cv_null_ilfm[df_mod$species == sp] <- predict(m0, newdata = filter(df_mod, species == sp),
                                                       allow.new.levels = TRUE)
}
null_cv_r2 <- r2_species_weighted(df_mod$ilfm, df_mod$cv_null_ilfm, df_mod$species)
null_cv_rmse <- rmse(df_mod$ilfm, df_mod$cv_null_ilfm)
cat(sprintf("Fig 9: %d species, %d obs; in-sample R2 %.3f (Psi-only %.3f); CV R2 %.3f (Psi-only %.3f); CV RMSE %.3f (Psi-only %.3f)\n",
            n_distinct(df_mod$species), nrow(df_mod), in_sample_r2, null_in_r2, cv_r2, null_cv_r2,
            cv_rmse, null_cv_rmse))
df_mod %>%
  mutate(salvia = species %in% c("SALLEU", "SALMEL")) %>%
  group_by(salvia) %>%
  summarise(bias_model = mean(ilfm - cv_predicted_ilfm), rmse_model = rmse(ilfm, cv_predicted_ilfm),
            bias_psi_only = mean(ilfm - cv_null_ilfm), rmse_psi_only = rmse(ilfm, cv_null_ilfm)) %>%
  print()

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Build Publication-Ready Plots
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Find the absolute min and max across ALL predictions and observations 
min_val <- min(c(df_mod$ilfm, df_mod$predicted_ilfm, df_mod$cv_predicted_ilfm), na.rm = TRUE)
max_val <- max(c(df_mod$ilfm, df_mod$predicted_ilfm, df_mod$cv_predicted_ilfm), na.rm = TRUE)

anno_text_insample <- sprintf("In-Sample R2 = %.2f\nRMSE = %.2f", in_sample_r2, in_sample_rmse)
anno_text_cv <- sprintf("Predictive R2 = %.2f (species-weighted)\nRMSE = %.2f\nΨ-only: R2 = %.2f, RMSE = %.2f", cv_r2, cv_rmse, null_cv_r2, null_cv_rmse)

# Custom color palette
my_colors <- c(
  "Gymnosperm" = "#636B2F",       # Light Green
  "Salvia" = "#F768A1",           # Pink
  "Other Angiosperm" = "grey70"   # Default Grey
)
 df_mod <- df_mod %>%
  mutate(
    plot_group = factor(plot_group, levels = c("Gymnosperm", "Salvia", "Other Angiosperm"))
  ) %>%
  # Sorting by desc(plot_group) puts "Other Angiosperm" first in the dataframe
  arrange(desc(plot_group))
# Panel A: In-Sample Plot
plot_insample_pub <- ggplot(df_mod, aes(x = predicted_ilfm, y = ilfm)) +
  # Map the fill to our new plot_group
  geom_point(aes(fill = plot_group), alpha = 0.6, shape = 21, color = "black", size = 2.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = my_colors) +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, color = "black", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "#2C7FB8", linewidth = 1.2) +
  annotate("label", x = min_val, y = max_val, label = anno_text_insample,
           hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 5, fill = alpha("white", 0.85), label.size = 0) +
  labs(
    x = "Predicted iLFM (In-Sample)",
    y = "Observed iLFM",
    fill = "Plant Group" # Clean legend title
  ) +
  coord_fixed(xlim = c(min_val, max_val), ylim = c(min_val, max_val)) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black"),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 1),
    legend.position = "none" # Hide legend on the first plot so it doesn't duplicate
  )

# Panel B: Cross-Validation Plot
plot_cv_pub <- ggplot(df_mod, aes(x = cv_predicted_ilfm, y = ilfm)) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = plot_group), alpha = 0.6, shape = 21, color = "black", size = 2.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = my_colors) +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, color = "black", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "#2C7FB8", linewidth = 1.2) +
  annotate("label", x = min_val, y = max_val, label = anno_text_cv,
           hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 5, fill = alpha("white", 0.85), label.size = 0) +
  labs(
    x = "Predicted iLFM (Unseen Species)",
    y = "Observed iLFM",
    fill = "Plant Group"
  ) +
  coord_fixed(xlim = c(min_val, max_val), ylim = c(min_val, max_val)) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black"),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 1) 
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Combine and Save
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Stitch together with patchwork and add A/B tags
# collect_guides() ensures we only have one clean legend for the whole figure
combined_plot <- plot_insample_pub + plot_cv_pub + 
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = 'A') +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") 

combined_plot

ggsave(
  filename = here("output", "figures", "main", "Fig_09_observed_vs_predicted.png"), 
  plot     = combined_plot,
  width    = 13,   # Added an extra inch of width to make room for the legend
  height   = 6,   
  units    = "in",
  dpi      = 300
)
```

####v3 (SI sensitivity): drought-deciduous species in pink
```{r}
# Same model and plots as Fig 9, but species are filtered only on the variables the
# model uses (Psi, LDMC, functional type), so species lacking P50/SLA/TLP stay in.
# Pink = all drought-deciduous species (leaf_habit_class() in 00_figure_setup.R).
leaf_habit_class <- local({ source(here("R", "00_figure_setup.R"), local = TRUE); leaf_habit_class })

df_dd <- q4_df %>%
  filter(!is.na(mwp), !is.na(ilfm), !is.na(ldmc), !is.na(species), !is.na(functional_type)) %>%
  mutate(
    mwp_z  = as.numeric(scale(mwp)),
    ldmc_z = as.numeric(scale(ldmc)),
    plot_group = case_when(
      grepl("gymnosperm", functional_type, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Gymnosperm",
      leaf_habit_class(species) == "Drought-deciduous" ~ "Drought-deciduous",
      TRUE ~ "Other Angiosperm"
    ),
    plot_group = factor(plot_group, levels = c("Gymnosperm", "Drought-deciduous", "Other Angiosperm"))
  )

cat("Species:", n_distinct(df_dd$species), "| added vs Fig 9:",
    paste(setdiff(unique(df_dd$species), unique(df_mod$species)), collapse = ", "), "\n")

dd_formula <- ilfm ~ mwp_z * ldmc_z + functional_type * mwp_z + (mwp_z | species)

dd_mod <- lmer(dd_formula, data = df_dd, REML = TRUE, control = ctrl_rs)
df_dd$predicted_ilfm <- predict(dd_mod)

# Leave-one-species-out
df_dd$cv_predicted_ilfm <- NA
for (sp in unique(df_dd$species)) {
  temp_mod <- lmer(dd_formula, data = df_dd %>% filter(species != sp), REML = FALSE, control = ctrl_rs)
  df_dd$cv_predicted_ilfm[df_dd$species == sp] <-
    predict(temp_mod, newdata = df_dd %>% filter(species == sp), allow.new.levels = TRUE)
}

dd_in_r2   <- cor(df_dd$ilfm, df_dd$predicted_ilfm)^2
dd_in_rmse <- rmse(df_dd$ilfm, df_dd$predicted_ilfm)
dd_cv_r2   <- r2_species_weighted(df_dd$ilfm, df_dd$cv_predicted_ilfm, df_dd$species)
dd_cv_rmse <- rmse(df_dd$ilfm, df_dd$cv_predicted_ilfm)

dd_lims <- range(c(df_dd$ilfm, df_dd$predicted_ilfm, df_dd$cv_predicted_ilfm), na.rm = TRUE)
dd_colors <- c("Gymnosperm" = "#636B2F", "Drought-deciduous" = "#F768A1", "Other Angiosperm" = "grey70")
df_dd <- df_dd %>% arrange(desc(plot_group))  # grey points drawn first

dd_panel <- function(xvar, xlab, label) {
  ggplot(df_dd, aes(x = .data[[xvar]], y = ilfm)) +
    geom_point(aes(fill = plot_group), alpha = 0.6, shape = 21, color = "black", size = 2.5) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = dd_colors) +
    geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, color = "black", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "#2C7FB8", linewidth = 1.2) +
    annotate("text", x = dd_lims[1], y = dd_lims[2], label = label, hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 5) +
    labs(x = xlab, y = "Observed iLFM", fill = "Plant Group") +
    coord_fixed(xlim = dd_lims, ylim = dd_lims) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
      axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black"),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 1)
    )
}

dd_plot <- dd_panel("predicted_ilfm", "Predicted iLFM (In-Sample)",
                    sprintf("In-Sample R2 = %.2f\nRMSE = %.2f", dd_in_r2, dd_in_rmse)) +
  dd_panel("cv_predicted_ilfm", "Predicted iLFM (Unseen Species)",
           sprintf("Predictive R2 = %.2f (species-weighted)\nRMSE = %.2f", dd_cv_r2, dd_cv_rmse)) +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A") +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect")

dd_plot

ggsave(
  filename = here("output", "figures", "SI", "unused_fig9_drought_deciduous.png"),
  plot = dd_plot, width = 13, height = 6, units = "in", dpi = 300
)
```

#Version with just angiosperms: 

###Table S6: Final model selection, no gymnos:
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(Metrics)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(here)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Prepare the Master Dataset
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# We must drop NAs for all variables used in ANY of the 9 models
# so they are all compared on the exact same dataset.
df_mod <- q4_df %>%
  filter(!species %in% c("SALLEU", "SALMEL")) %>%  # Salvias are outliers (see Q3)
  filter(
    !is.na(mwp), !is.na(ilfm), !is.na(plc50_stem), !is.na(sla), 
    !is.na(ldmc), !is.na(psi_tlp), !is.na(functional_type), !is.na(species)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    mwp_z    = as.numeric(scale(mwp)),
    p50_z    = as.numeric(scale(plc50_stem)),
    sla_z    = as.numeric(scale(sla)),
    tlp_z    = as.numeric(scale(psi_tlp)),
    ldmc_z   = as.numeric(scale(ldmc)),
    functional_type = as.factor(functional_type)
  ) %>% 
  filter(functional_type == "angiosperm")

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Define Your 9 A Priori Models
# ---------------------------------------------------------
formulas <- list(
  "P50 + SLA + LDMC + TLP" = ilfm ~ mwp_z * p50_z + mwp_z * sla_z + mwp_z * ldmc_z + mwp_z * tlp_z + (mwp_z | species),

  "P50 + SLA + LDMC" = ilfm ~ mwp_z * p50_z + mwp_z * sla_z + mwp_z * ldmc_z + (mwp_z | species),

  "TLP + SLA + LDMC" = ilfm ~ mwp_z * tlp_z + mwp_z * sla_z + mwp_z * ldmc_z + (mwp_z | species),

  "SLA + LDMC" = ilfm ~ mwp_z * sla_z + mwp_z * ldmc_z + (mwp_z | species),

  "TLP + P50" = ilfm ~ mwp_z * p50_z + mwp_z * tlp_z + (mwp_z | species),

  "SLA + TLP" = ilfm ~ mwp_z * sla_z + mwp_z * tlp_z + (mwp_z | species),

  "LDMC + TLP" = ilfm ~ mwp_z * ldmc_z + mwp_z * tlp_z + (mwp_z | species),

  "SLA + P50" = ilfm ~ mwp_z * sla_z + mwp_z * p50_z + (mwp_z | species),

  "LDMC + P50" = ilfm ~ mwp_z * ldmc_z + mwp_z * p50_z + (mwp_z | species),

  "SLA Only" = ilfm ~ mwp_z * sla_z + (mwp_z | species),

  "TLP Only" = ilfm ~ mwp_z * tlp_z + (mwp_z | species),

  "P50 Only" = ilfm ~ mwp_z * p50_z + (mwp_z | species),

  "LDMC Only" = ilfm ~ mwp_z * ldmc_z + (mwp_z | species),

  "WP Only (Null)" = ilfm ~ mwp_z + (mwp_z | species)
)
formulas_angio <- formulas

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Evaluate Models and Run Cross-Validation
# ---------------------------------------------------------
results_list <- list()
species_list <- unique(df_mod$species)

cat("Running evaluations and cross-validation for 9 hypothesis-driven models...\n")

for(model_name in names(formulas)) {
  
  current_formula <- formulas[[model_name]]
  
  # A. Fit Full Model (REML = FALSE is required to compare fixed effects with AIC)
  full_mod <- lmer(current_formula, data = df_mod, REML = FALSE, control = ctrl_rs)
  
  # B. Calculate AIC & In-Sample R2
  mod_aic <- AIC(full_mod)
  in_sample_preds <- predict(full_mod)
  in_sample_r2 <- cor(df_mod$ilfm, in_sample_preds)^2
  
  # C. Leave-One-Species-Out CV Loop
  cv_preds <- numeric(nrow(df_mod))
  
  for(sp in species_list) {
    train_data <- df_mod %>% filter(species != sp)
    test_data  <- df_mod %>% filter(species == sp)
    
    cv_mod <- lmer(current_formula, data = train_data, REML = FALSE, control = ctrl_rs)
    cv_preds[df_mod$species == sp] <- predict(cv_mod, newdata = test_data, allow.new.levels = TRUE)
  }
  cv_r2 <- r2_species_weighted(df_mod$ilfm, cv_preds, df_mod$species)
  cv_r2_pooled <- cor(df_mod$ilfm, cv_preds)^2
  
  # D. Store Results
  results_list[[model_name]] <- data.frame(
    Model = model_name,
    AIC = mod_aic,
    In_Sample_R2 = in_sample_r2,
    Cross_Val_R2 = cv_r2,
    Cross_Val_R2_pooled = cv_r2_pooled
  )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Format the Dataframe
# ---------------------------------------------------------
model_comparison_df <- do.call(rbind, results_list)

min_aic <- min(model_comparison_df$AIC)

final_df <- model_comparison_df %>%
  mutate(Delta_AIC = AIC - min_aic) %>%
  arrange(Delta_AIC) %>%
  # Round numbers for clean presentation
  mutate(
    AIC = round(AIC, 1),
    Delta_AIC = round(Delta_AIC, 1),
    In_Sample_R2 = round(In_Sample_R2, 3),
    Cross_Val_R2 = round(Cross_Val_R2, 3),
    Cross_Val_R2_pooled = round(Cross_Val_R2_pooled, 3)
  ) %>%
  # Clean up headers
  rename(
    `Candidate Model` = Model,
    `Delta AIC` = Delta_AIC,
    `In-Sample R-squared` = In_Sample_R2,
    `Cross-Val R-squared (species-weighted)` = Cross_Val_R2,
    `Cross-Val R-squared (pooled obs)` = Cross_Val_R2_pooled
  )

rownames(final_df) <- NULL

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Create and Save the Publication kable Table
# ---------------------------------------------------------
pub_table <- kable(final_df, format = "html", escape = FALSE, align = "lccccc") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE, position = "left") %>%
  # Highlight the best model row in bold
  row_spec(1, bold = TRUE) 

# Print to Viewer
pub_table

# Save as an HTML file for easy copy/pasting into Word
write.csv(final_df, here("output", "tables", "Table_S07_model_comparison_angiosperms.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
tryCatch(save_kable(pub_table, file = here("output", "tables", "Table_S07_model_comparison_angiosperms.html")), error = function(e) message("Note: HTML table skipped (pandoc not available)"))

cat("Done! Table saved to figures/Table_Hypothesis_Models_nogymno.html\n")
```

#Table S8: model comparison with the two Salvia species included (Table S7 sensitivity)
```{r table_s7_with_salvia}
# Same candidate models, random structure and species-weighted LOSO CV as the main Table S7,
# but keeping SALLEU and SALMEL (excluded from the main comparison as behavioural outliers)
run_model_comparison <- function(d, fxs) {
  sp_list <- unique(d$species)
  res <- lapply(names(fxs), function(model_name) {
    f <- fxs[[model_name]]
    full_mod <- lmer(f, data = d, REML = FALSE, control = ctrl_rs)
    cv_preds <- numeric(nrow(d))
    for (sp in sp_list) {
      cv_mod <- lmer(f, data = d[d$species != sp, ], REML = FALSE, control = ctrl_rs)
      cv_preds[d$species == sp] <- predict(cv_mod, newdata = d[d$species == sp, ], allow.new.levels = TRUE)
    }
    data.frame(
      Model               = model_name,
      AIC                 = AIC(full_mod),
      In_Sample_R2        = cor(d$ilfm, predict(full_mod))^2,
      Cross_Val_R2        = r2_species_weighted(d$ilfm, cv_preds, d$species),
      Cross_Val_R2_pooled = cor(d$ilfm, cv_preds)^2
    )
  })
  do.call(rbind, res) %>%
    mutate(Delta_AIC = AIC - min(AIC)) %>%
    arrange(Delta_AIC) %>%
    mutate(across(c(AIC, Delta_AIC), ~ round(.x, 1)),
           across(c(In_Sample_R2, Cross_Val_R2, Cross_Val_R2_pooled), ~ round(.x, 3))) %>%
    rename(`Candidate Model` = Model, `Delta AIC` = Delta_AIC,
           `In-Sample R-squared` = In_Sample_R2,
           `Cross-Val R-squared (species-weighted)` = Cross_Val_R2,
           `Cross-Val R-squared (pooled obs)` = Cross_Val_R2_pooled)
}

# No P50 range filter here, so ADEFAS (-8.4 MPa) and CEACUN (-9.6 MPa) are kept (21 species)
df_salvia <- q4_df %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(mwp), !is.na(ilfm), !is.na(plc50_stem), !is.na(sla),
    !is.na(ldmc), !is.na(psi_tlp), !is.na(functional_type), !is.na(species)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    mwp_z    = as.numeric(scale(mwp)),
    p50_z    = as.numeric(scale(plc50_stem)),
    sla_z    = as.numeric(scale(sla)),
    tlp_z    = as.numeric(scale(psi_tlp)),
    ldmc_z   = as.numeric(scale(ldmc)),
    functional_type = as.factor(functional_type)
  )
cat(sprintf("With Salvia: %d species (%d angiosperms)\n",
            n_distinct(df_salvia$species),
            n_distinct(df_salvia$species[df_salvia$functional_type == "angiosperm"])))

s7_all_salvia   <- run_model_comparison(df_salvia, formulas_all)
s7_angio_salvia <- run_model_comparison(df_salvia %>% filter(functional_type == "angiosperm"), formulas_angio)

print(s7_all_salvia)
print(s7_angio_salvia)

write.csv(s7_all_salvia,   here("output", "tables", "Table_S08_model_comparison_withSalvia.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(s7_angio_salvia, here("output", "tables", "Table_S08_model_comparison_angiosperms_withSalvia.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

# ---------------------------------------------------------

  filter(functional_type == "angiosperm")

df_mod <- df %>%
  filter(!is.na(mwp), !is.na(ilfm), !is.na(plc50_stem), !is.na(sla), !is.na(ldmc), !is.na(species), !is.na(psi_tlp)) %>%

)

# Out-of-Sample (Leave-One-Species-Out)

for(sp in species_list) {
```

## ITV Sensitivity Analysis
Does intraspecific trait variation (ITV) explain which species the model predicts poorly?
If species with high trait CV have larger cross-val residuals, ITV is likely masking the
trait-iLFM signal. If not, the Ψ-iLFM relationship is likely genuinely conserved within
angiosperms regardless of trait variation.

```{r itv_sensitivity}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)

spcodes <- read_csv(here("data", "SpCodes.csv"))

# --- 1. Per-species mean absolute cross-val residual (from angio fig chunk above) ---
sp_residuals <- df_mod %>%
  mutate(abs_resid = abs(ilfm - cv_predicted_ilfm)) %>%
  group_by(species) %>%
  summarise(mean_abs_resid = mean(abs_resid, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(spcodes %>% select(SpCode6, Genus_species), by = c("species" = "SpCode6"))

# --- 2. SLA CV from raw TRY data ---
# NOTE: requires try_all_20241014.csv (not in repo). If unavailable, SLA CV is skipped.
try_path <- "/Users/user/Desktop/github/older projects/pepperwood/data/try_all_20241014.csv"

sla_names <- c("SLA", "SLA (cm2 g-1)", "SLA  (cm2/g)", "SLA(cm2/g)",
                "sla", "SLA: petiole and rachis excluded",
                "Specific leaf area", "Specific Leaf Area",
                "leaf area per leaf mass (SLA)")

if (file.exists(try_path)) {
  sla_cv <- read.csv(try_path) %>%
    filter(OriglName %in% sla_names, !is.na(StdValue), StdValue > 0) %>%
    mutate(Genus_species = word(AccSpeciesName, 1, 2)) %>%
    group_by(Genus_species) %>%
    summarise(sla_cv = sd(StdValue, na.rm = TRUE) / mean(StdValue, na.rm = TRUE),
              sla_n  = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    filter(sla_n >= 3)
} else {
  message("Raw TRY file not found; SLA CV omitted from ITV analysis.")
  sla_cv <- tibble(Genus_species = character(), sla_cv = numeric(), sla_n = integer())
}

# --- 3. Load pre-computed LDMC and P50 CVs (from TRY, stored in repo) ---
try_cvs <- read_csv(here("data", "other_studies", "try-cvs.csv")) %>%
  rename(Genus_species = 1) %>%
  select(Genus_species, ldmc_cv = LDMC, p50_cv = `P50..MPa.`) %>%
  mutate(across(c(ldmc_cv, p50_cv), abs))

# --- 4. Join residuals with CVs ---
itv_df <- sp_residuals %>%
  left_join(sla_cv  %>% select(Genus_species, sla_cv),  by = "Genus_species") %>%
  left_join(try_cvs,                                     by = "Genus_species")

# --- 5. Spearman correlations ---
cor_sla  <- cor.test(itv_df$mean_abs_resid, itv_df$sla_cv,  method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs")
cor_ldmc <- cor.test(itv_df$mean_abs_resid, itv_df$ldmc_cv, method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs")
cor_p50  <- cor.test(itv_df$mean_abs_resid, itv_df$p50_cv,  method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs")

cat("SLA CV  vs residual: rho =", round(cor_sla$estimate,  2), "  p =", round(cor_sla$p.value,  3), "\n")
cat("LDMC CV vs residual: rho =", round(cor_ldmc$estimate, 2), "  p =", round(cor_ldmc$p.value, 3), "\n")
cat("P50 CV  vs residual: rho =", round(cor_p50$estimate,  2), "  p =", round(cor_p50$p.value,  3), "\n")

# --- 6. Plot ---
itv_long <- itv_df %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(sla_cv, ldmc_cv, p50_cv),
               names_to = "trait", values_to = "cv") %>%
  filter(!is.na(cv)) %>%
  mutate(trait = dplyr::recode(trait,
    "sla_cv"  = "SLA",
    "ldmc_cv" = "LDMC",
    "p50_cv"  = "P50"
  ))

ggplot(itv_long, aes(x = cv, y = mean_abs_resid)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 2.5) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "#2C7FB8", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_text(aes(label = species), size = 2.5, vjust = -0.6, alpha = 0.6) +
  facet_wrap(~ trait, scales = "free_x") +
  labs(
    x = "Trait CV (intraspecific SD / mean, from TRY)",
    y = "Mean absolute cross-val residual (iLFM)",
    title = "ITV sensitivity: does trait variability predict model error?"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  theme(strip.background = element_blank(), strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))
```

## Supplemental Equations for Vegetation Modelers (Angiosperms Only)

Two equations for use by modelers without site-specific calibration data.
Conifers are excluded: gymnosperm ψ–LFM dynamics differ fundamentally (positive
slopes in this dataset) and sample size (n = 2) is insufficient for a valid trait equation.

### Equation 1: Real-time LFM (requires contemporaneous ψ)

Best angiosperm model in Table S7 by species-weighted leave-one-species-out R² (LDMC × Ψ,
species random slopes), fit to the same species as Table S7.

```{r supp_eq1_realtime_lfm}
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)

# Same species as the Table S7 angiosperm comparison (Salvia excluded,
# complete traits); z-scores computed on these data so the equation is self-contained
df_angio <- q4_df %>%
  filter(!species %in% c("SALLEU", "SALMEL")) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(mwp), !is.na(ilfm), !is.na(plc50_stem), !is.na(sla),
    !is.na(ldmc), !is.na(psi_tlp), !is.na(functional_type), !is.na(species)
  ) %>%
  filter(functional_type == "angiosperm") %>%
  mutate(
    mwp_z  = as.numeric(scale(mwp)),
    ldmc_z = as.numeric(scale(ldmc))
  )
cat(sprintf("Eq S2 data: %d observations, %d species\n", nrow(df_angio), n_distinct(df_angio$species)))

# Refit CV-best angiosperm model (LDMC only, Table_S07_model_comparison_angiosperms)
mod_eq1 <- lmer(
  ilfm ~ mwp_z * ldmc_z + (mwp_z | species),
  data = df_angio,
  REML = TRUE,
  control = ctrl_rs
)

# Fixed-effect coefficients
cat("=== Supplemental Equation S2: Real-Time iLFM (Angiosperms) ===\n")
cat("iLFM = β0 + β1·Ψz + β2·LDMCz + β3·(Ψz × LDMCz) + u_s + v_s·Ψz\n")
cat("  where _z = z-standardized; u_s, v_s = species random intercept and slope (0 for novel species)\n\n")

coefs_eq1 <- round(fixef(mod_eq1), 4)
print(coefs_eq1)

# Same equation in raw units (Ψ in MPa, LDMC in g/g), from the unrounded coefficients
fe <- fixef(mod_eq1)
mu_p <- mean(df_angio$mwp);  sd_p <- sd(df_angio$mwp)
mu_l <- mean(df_angio$ldmc); sd_l <- sd(df_angio$ldmc)
raw_int  <- fe[1] - fe[2] * mu_p / sd_p - fe[3] * mu_l / sd_l + fe[4] * mu_p * mu_l / (sd_p * sd_l)
raw_psi  <- fe[2] / sd_p - fe[4] * mu_l / (sd_p * sd_l)
raw_ldmc <- fe[3] / sd_l - fe[4] * mu_p / (sd_p * sd_l)
raw_int2 <- fe[4] / (sd_p * sd_l)
cat(sprintf("Raw units: iLFM = %.4f %+.4f·Ψ %+.3f·LDMC %+.3f·(Ψ × LDMC)\n\n",
            raw_int, raw_psi, raw_ldmc, raw_int2))

# Standardization parameters — modelers must apply these to their raw values
std_params <- df_angio %>%
  summarise(
    mwp_mean  = round(mean(mwp,  na.rm = TRUE), 4), mwp_sd  = round(sd(mwp,  na.rm = TRUE), 4),
    ldmc_mean = round(mean(ldmc, na.rm = TRUE), 4), ldmc_sd = round(sd(ldmc, na.rm = TRUE), 4)
  )

cat("\nStandardization parameters (x_z = (x - mean) / sd):\n")
print(t(std_params))

cat("\nConvert iLFM back to LFM (%): LFM = (1 / iLFM) × 100\n")

# Model performance
cv_pred_eq1 <- rep(NA, nrow(df_angio))
for (sp in unique(df_angio$species)) {
  train <- df_angio %>% filter(species != sp)
  test  <- df_angio %>% filter(species == sp)
  m_cv  <- lmer(ilfm ~ mwp_z * ldmc_z + (mwp_z | species),
                data = train, REML = FALSE, control = ctrl_rs)
  cv_pred_eq1[df_angio$species == sp] <- predict(m_cv, newdata = test,
                                                   allow.new.levels = TRUE)
}
r2_eq1 <- r2_species_weighted(df_angio$ilfm, cv_pred_eq1, df_angio$species)
cat(sprintf("\nCross-val R² (LOSO, angiosperms, species-weighted): %.3f\n", r2_eq1))
```

### Equation 2: LFMmin (trait-only, no contemporaneous ψ required)

Species-level regression of minimum seasonal LFM on functional traits.
Modelers supply only trait values from a database; no real-time measurements needed.

```{r supp_eq2_lfmmin}
# Species-level data (one row per angiosperm species). Salvia excluded, as in Table S7,
# Eq S2 and Fig 9: with them included the LFMmin ~ LDMC relationship disappears (see Q3).
angio_sp <- q3_df %>%
  filter(functional_type == "angiosperm",
         !species %in% c("SALLEU", "SALMEL"),
         !is.na(min_lfm), !is.na(plc50_stem), !is.na(sla), !is.na(ldmc), !is.na(psi_tlp)) %>%
  mutate(min_lfm_pct = min_lfm * 100)  # convert to % for interpretability

cat(sprintf("Angiosperms with complete trait data: n = %d species\n\n", nrow(angio_sp)))

# Select the trait model by leave-one-species-out cross-validation (each row is a species),
# over every combination of P50, SLA, LDMC and TLP
eq2_traits <- c("plc50_stem", "sla", "ldmc", "psi_tlp")
eq2_cands  <- unlist(lapply(seq_along(eq2_traits), function(k) combn(eq2_traits, k, simplify = FALSE)),
                     recursive = FALSE)

loo_r2 <- function(f, d) {
  pred <- sapply(seq_len(nrow(d)), function(i) predict(lm(f, d[-i, ]), d[i, ]))
  1 - sum((d$min_lfm_pct - pred)^2) / sum((d$min_lfm_pct - mean(d$min_lfm_pct))^2)
}

eq2_table <- map_dfr(eq2_cands, function(v) {
  f <- as.formula(paste("min_lfm_pct ~", paste(v, collapse = " + ")))
  m <- lm(f, data = angio_sp)
  tibble(model  = paste(v, collapse = " + "),
         R2     = summary(m)$r.squared,
         adj_R2 = summary(m)$adj.r.squared,
         LOO_R2 = loo_r2(f, angio_sp))
}) %>%
  arrange(desc(LOO_R2))

cat("=== Candidate trait models for LFMmin (ranked by leave-one-species-out R²) ===\n")
print(eq2_table %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 3))))

# Parsimony: among models within 0.02 LOO R² of the best, take the fewest traits
# (P50 + LDMC + TLP and P50 + LDMC differ by 0.01; TLP p = 0.33)
eq2_best <- eq2_table %>%
  mutate(n_terms = lengths(strsplit(model, " \\+ "))) %>%
  filter(LOO_R2 >= max(LOO_R2) - 0.02) %>%
  arrange(n_terms, desc(LOO_R2)) %>%
  slice(1) %>% pull(model)
mod_eq2  <- lm(as.formula(paste("min_lfm_pct ~", eq2_best)), data = angio_sp)
cat("\n=== CV-best model:", eq2_best, "===\n")
print(summary(mod_eq2))

# Format final equation coefficients for manuscript
trait_labels <- c(plc50_stem = "P50", sla = "SLA", ldmc = "LDMC", psi_tlp = "TLP")
b <- coef(mod_eq2)
cat("\n=== Supplemental Equation 2: LFMmin (%) ===\n")
cat(sprintf("LFMmin = %.3f%s\n", b[1],
            paste(sprintf(" %s %.3f·%s", ifelse(b[-1] < 0, "−", "+"), abs(b[-1]), trait_labels[names(b)[-1]]),
                  collapse = "")))
cat(sprintf("  n = %d species; R² = %.2f; leave-one-species-out R² = %.2f\n",
            nrow(angio_sp), summary(mod_eq2)$r.squared, eq2_table$LOO_R2[eq2_table$model == eq2_best]))
cat("  P50 and TLP in MPa; SLA in cm² g⁻¹; LDMC as proportion (g g⁻¹)\n")
cat("  Applies to angiosperms only (Salvia excluded)\n")

# Plot: observed vs. predicted LFMmin
angio_sp$lfmmin_pred <- predict(mod_eq2)

ggplot(angio_sp, aes(x = lfmmin_pred, y = min_lfm_pct)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sp_code), size = 2.8, vjust = -0.7, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "#2C7FB8", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(
    x = "Predicted LFMmin (%) — trait-based equation",
    y = "Observed LFMmin (%)",
    title = "Supplemental Equation 2: LFMmin from traits only (angiosperms)"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13)
```
